newsitem.title: UK: Reed up sharply as bid talk returns.
newsitem.headline: Reed up sharply as bid talk returns.

text.p: Shares in Reed International Plc were the second biggest gainers in the FTSE 100 index by late afternoon on Wednesday as bid speculation returned on the stock, dealers said.
Following recent sharp gains in perceieved bid targets such as Reckitt & Colman Plc, dealers said speculative attention had swung back to Reed, up 39p or 3.4 percent at 11.81-1/2 stg by 1543 GMT.
Trading volume reached a modest 1.3 million shares.
"There has been a lot of takeover talk again in the market," said one dealer, "and Reed is the one they are talking about today."
Reed shares have rallied strongly in recent weeks from the 11-month low of 10.15 stg set mid January on talk of disposals and a possible bid.
